Impacted Systems: Android devices, Users of 56 different European banks in Spain, Portugal, Italy, and Belgium
Method of Attack: Steals banking information by intercepting notifications, logging SMS, and performing overlay attacks to snatch credentials and one-time passwords
Requests Accessibility Service permissions and abuses privileges to grant itself additional permissions
Attack Vector: Distributed through Google Play Store via generic performance-boosting applications such as 'Fast Cleaner'
